title: Chainalysis Sues US Government Over $94.6M ICE Contract Handed to Rival TRM Labs
summary: The bid protest, filed in the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, challenges ICE's sole-source award for blockchain forensic tools, pitting the two biggest names in crypto tracing against each other.
